title: 第25章 猪人肥二第26章 成立战斧家族
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
华叔不愧为福布斯.狐族，不到半天时间，就已经以两万一千斤粮食，低价买下了一个偏大的院落。地段，自然算不上繁华，但也不偏僻，属于十字交叉口。
此院主，是个猪族粮食商人，因为运粮队伍被劫，赔的血本无归。没有办法，只能卖院赔偿投资者的损失，成为了落魄商人的典范。
在华叔的一再压价下，从两万八讲到两万一，气的猪人商人，气管炎都快犯了。华叔的口才，让在旁边的小奇崇拜不已，激动的都想拜师了。
猪人商人也是没办法，重点是其它的买主，一下付不出这么多粮食，他又急着还账。一个正常猪人一家，也就收入几千斤，去掉自己用的，几乎没有剩余。可见，这个猪人粮食商人，也算有些才能的。
“肥二，你们以后怎么打算？”
孙云亲自交易完成后，问猪人商人！
在交易的时候，孙云自然知道这猪人商人的姓名，简单的简直无语了。当然了，以猪族人的习性，这也是属于正常情况，对他们来说，名字只是个代号罢了。
“还能怎么办，到部落外承包一块地，种地去呗！”
猪人商人，苦笑着回答道。
是的，这也是商人与大众的区别，他们永远不会坐吃等死。大多数猪族人，只会选择种植自己的那块地，不会去花代价包地，毕竟劫匪太多，有被抢的风险。
与猪族人对立的豪猪一族，就是游荡的劫匪，他们靠四处抢夺为生。
“你还有妻儿老小，包地太危险了。不如这样，我聘请你为我做事，酬劳你看着要，还是做你那粮食买卖！”
孙云非常有诚意的说道。
要想融入猪人部落，单靠火狐人肯定不行，需要本地猪人协助。而这猪人肥二，绝对是最好的人选，智力和人脉都很不错。
“这！你能相信我？”
猪人肥二，有些自卑的问道。
毕竟，自从他这次赔了之后，就成为了部落的笑柄。都纷纷嘲笑他不自量力，接下那么大的单子，搞的一下回到解放前！
要不是，自己平时讲诚信，债主早就把他送官了。就算是这样，他卖掉了院落也不够，还得把自己安身立命的店铺变卖，才有可能还清债务。
“当然相信，你不是在处理粮食店吗？这样，你估个价直接转给我，你还是那个店的老板。你的家人还住这里，你老婆管我们这的后勤，待遇你看着要，就以最高标准就行了！”
孙云见对方没有拒绝，赶紧趁热打铁。

自已现在人数不少了，生活用品和吃饭，都是大问题。人家是土生土长的本地人，这些事自然在行，自已正好也做个顺水人情。
“不不不，她没有干过，就普通待遇就好了！”
猪人肥二，赶紧紧张的说道。
“谁说的，你一家的吃喝拉撒，还不是靠我。你放心，我绝对给你办的妥妥的，待遇没关系，您看着给就行了！”
猪人肥二的老婆，不但是女强人，看来还是人精。
孙云现在的表现，明显是不熟悉行情，也正是用人的时候。孙云自己给的薪酬，自然不会太低，如果让自己张嘴要，那就说不出口了。
“那行，既然嫂子答应了，就直接上岗吧！你看，我这么多人，还没有地方睡觉呢，您可有的忙了！”
孙云一看肥二老婆答应了，赶紧苦大仇深的说道！
“好好，这点小事，就交给我了！你们这些大男人，多研究一些大事，这种事不用你们操心！”
猪人肥二的老婆，也是个雷厉风行的人，直接去安排了。
“这……这妇道人家，兄弟别见怪啊！”
猪人肥二，尴尬的说道！
“谁说的，嫂子可比你豪爽多了，你算是捡到宝了！”
孙云一本正经的说道！
还没走远了的肥二老婆，听到孙云的话，喜滋滋的跑去忙了。后勤管事，可都是男猪人干的事，她要是干的出色了，可就是名副其实的女强人了。
content_en:
Uncle Hua is worthy of the Forbes Fox clan. In less than half a day, he had bought a relatively large courtyard at a low price with 21,000 kilograms of grain. The location is naturally not prosperous, but it is not remote either and belongs to a crossroads.
The owner of this hospital is a grain merchant of the pig tribe. Because his grain transport team was robbed, he lost all his money. He had no choice but to sell the hospital to compensate investors for their losses, and became a model of a down-and-out businessman.
Under Uncle Hua's repeated price reductions, from 28,000 to 21,000, the pig businessman was so angry that he almost had bronchitis. Uncle Hua's eloquence made Xiao Qi admire him so much that he was so excited that he wanted to become his disciple.
The pig merchant had no choice. The point was that other buyers couldn't pay for so much food at once, and he was in a hurry to pay back the debt. A normal pig family only earns a few thousand kilograms, and after excluding what they use for their own use, there is almost no surplus. It can be seen that this pig food merchant is also quite talented.
"Fei Er, what are your plans for the future?"
After Sun Yun completed the transaction in person, he asked the pig merchant!
During the transaction, Sun Yun naturally knew the name of the pig businessman, and he was simply speechless. Of course, according to the habits of the pig people, this is also a normal situation. For them, the name is just a code name.
"What else can we do? Contract a piece of land outside the tribe and start farming!"
The pig merchant replied with a wry smile.
Yes, this is also the difference between businessmen and the public. They will never sit back and wait to die. Most pig people will only choose to plant their own land and will not pay for it. After all, there are too many robbers and there is a risk of being robbed.
The porcupine clan, which is the opposite of the pig clan, are wandering robbers who make a living by robbing everywhere.
"You still have a wife and children, so it's too dangerous to own the land. How about this, I hire you to work for me, and you can pay whatever you want, but you can still do your grain business!"
Sun Yun said very sincerely.
If you want to integrate into the pig tribe, you will definitely not be able to rely on the firefox people alone. You will need the help of the local pig people. And this pig-man Fat Er is definitely the best candidate, with very good intelligence and connections.
"This! Can you believe me?"
Fatty Pig asked with some inferiority complex.
After all, since he lost this time, he has become the laughing stock of the tribe. They all laughed at him for not overestimating his capabilities and taking on such a big deal. He was suddenly back before liberation!
If he hadn't always been honest, his creditors would have sent him to court long ago. Even so, it was not enough for him to sell the courtyard. He also had to sell the shop where he settled down to be able to pay off his debts.
"Of course I believe it. Aren't you in charge of a grain store? In this way, you can estimate the price and transfer it directly to me. You will still be the owner of that store. Your family still lives here, and your wife is in charge of our logistics. You can be treated according to the highest standards as long as you want it!"
Seeing that the other party did not refuse, Sun Yun quickly struck while the iron was hot.
Now that we have a lot of people, daily necessities and food are big problems. As a native born and raised here, he is naturally good at these things, and he just happens to be a favor.
"No, no, no, she hasn't done it before, just treat her as normal!"
Pig Man Fat Er said quickly and nervously.
"Who said that, your family's food, drink, and toilet are not dependent on me. Don't worry, I will definitely take care of it for you. It doesn't matter the salary, just pay it as you see it!"
The wife of Pig Man Fat Er is not only a strong woman, but she also seems to be a human spirit.
Sun Yun's current performance is obviously unfamiliar with the market, and it is the right time to hire people. The salary Sun Yun gave himself was naturally not too low. If he asked for it, he would not be able to say it.
"Okay, since my sister-in-law agreed, let's go straight to work! Look, there are so many of us, and I don't even have a place to sleep, so you are very busy!"
When Sun Yun saw that the fat second wife agreed, he quickly said bitterly and with deep hatred!
"Okay, leave this little thing to me! You grown men, study moreIt’s a big deal, you don’t need to worry about this kind of thing! "
Pig Man Fat Er's wife was also a resolute person, so she went directly to make arrangements.
"This...this woman is a woman, brother, don't be surprised! "
Pig Man Fat Er said awkwardly!
"Who said that? My sister-in-law is much more generous than you. You have found a treasure! "
Sun Yun said seriously!
The fat second wife, who had not gone far, heard Sun Yun's words and ran to get busy happily. Logistics management is all done by male pigs. If she does a good job, she will be a real strong woman.
